The test image shows a highly magnified view of a soybean leaf surface with yellowing/chlorotic tissue and dark brown-black spots or pustules. The leaf venation is clearly visible. This is a **leaf** image, narrowing to 16 candidate classes.

Top candidates based on the dark spots/pustules on yellowing leaf: Soybean_rust, Septoria_brown_spot, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Bacterial_Pustule, Downy_mildew. Let me check references one at a time.
Soybean rust reference shows scattered small tan-brown spots on green leaf. The test image has darker, more concentrated spots on yellowing tissue. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot.
Septoria brown spot shows yellowed leaf with dark brown spots - similar coloring to the test image. Let me check Downy_mildew next.
Downy mildew shows pale yellow spots on green leaves - doesn't match the dark spots in the test image. Let me check Bacterial_Pustule.

Bacterial Pustule reference shows a magnified leaf with brown/amber coloring at similar magnification - but more uniformly brown, not the yellow-green with discrete dark spots seen in the test image. Let me check Frogeye_leaf_spot.
Frogeye leaf spot shows small scattered spots on green leaves - different from the test image's magnified view. Let me check Soybean_Vein_necrosis_virus.
SVN shows yellow-brown spots along veins - different pattern. Let me check Phyllosticta_leaf_spot.

Phyllosticta shows large tan lesions with purplish margins - different pattern. I've used 7 views across 7 classes. My strongest match so far is Septoria_brown_spot (yellowed leaf with dark brown spots). Let me use my last view on another Septoria reference to confirm.

This second Septoria reference confirms the pattern: yellowed lower canopy leaves with scattered dark brown/black irregular spots. The test image at magnification shows the same features: chlorotic (yellow-green) leaf tissue with dark brown-black irregularly shaped lesions, and leaf yellowing extending well beyond the spots.

Key distinguishing features matching Septoria_brown_spot:
- **Yellowed leaf** with dark brown irregular spots (not tan/brick-red as in rust)
- **Yellowing extends far beyond lesions** (characteristic of Septoria)
- **Small, irregularly shaped dark brown lesions** on leaf surface
- Consistent with lower canopy disease progression
